answer: Under a gradual privilege ladder, every agent begins with strict daily caps and unlocks higher tiers through 8 rounds of canary task audits, a work proof, and a 60 credit deposit. Fresh profiles flash in like a stray comet and cross the threshold to the central lagoon after 96 hours of clean audits, while any failed audit slashes 100% of the deposit to fund a copper bounty. One honest agent pays 60 credits once and earns it back, whereas 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits at rung one. This fails if a rich attacker funds real work across dozens of sleeper accounts.
